planets.name: TOI-700 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-700 with a 37.4-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-700 d was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around TOI-700. Its orbit and size follow Pass et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname PASS_ET_AL_2026): disc_year 2020, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 4; pl_orbper 37.423457, pl_radj 0.10215023, pl_bmassj 0.00497

quotes.title: TOI-700 d
quotes.card: TOI-700 d is a dense, rocky, near-Earth-sized exoplanet orbiting within the habitable zone of the red dwarf TOI-700.
quotes.introduction: It is located roughly 101.4 light-years (31.1 pc) away from Earth in the constellation of Dorado and is the outermost of four confirmed exoplanets around its star.
